# Psalm 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-Miktam of-David. Preserve-me, O-God, for I-take-refuge in-You.

**2** I-say to-YHWH, "You [are] my-Lord; my-good [is] not apart-from-You."

**3** As-for the-holy-ones who [are] in-the-land, they [are] the-majestic-ones — all my-delight [is] in-them.

**4** Their-sorrows shall-multiply [who] exchange [YHWH for] another; I-will-not pour-out their-drink-offerings of-blood, and-I-will-not take-up their-names upon my-lips.

**5** YHWH [is] the-portion of-my-inheritance and-my-cup; You hold my-lot.

**6** The-boundary-lines have-fallen for-me in-pleasant [places]; indeed, [my] inheritance is-beautiful to-me.

**7** I-bless YHWH who counsels-me; indeed, in-the-nights my-kidneys [inner being] instruct-me.

**8** I-set YHWH before-me always; because [He is] at-my-right-hand, I-shall-not be-shaken.

**9** Therefore my-heart is-glad and-my-glory [tongue] rejoices; also my-flesh dwells in-safety.

**10** For You-will-not abandon my-soul to-Sheol; You-will-not give Your-faithful-one to-see the-pit.

**11** You-make-known to-me the-path of-life; fullness of-joy [is] in-Your-presence; pleasures at-Your-right-hand forevermore.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **16:10**: Shachat can mean 'pit' or 'corruption/decay.' The ambiguity is significant — Peter interprets it as bodily corruption in Acts 2:27.

— EMET
